help.title: Page tutorial
help.description: Need help? Click here anytime to start an interactive walkthrough of the current page.

s0.title: Welcome to Smart Economat!
s0.description: This is your central dashboard. From here you get a real-time overview of everything happening in the pantry.

s1.title: Navigation menu
s1.description: Use the sidebar to move between areas. The menu adapts to your device.

s2.title: Pantry status
s2.description: Watch key KPIs at a glance: low stock, pending orders, and active incidents.

s3.title: Quick actions
s3.description: Need to create an order or add a product? Reach frequent actions without digging through menus.

s4.title: Notification center
s4.description: Monitor critical alerts: stock-outs, pending users, or urgent discrepancies.

s5.title: Recent activity
s5.description: Stay up to date with recent stock movements and operations.

s6.title: Your profile and preferences
s6.description: Manage your personal data and notifications. You can also reopen this help when you need it.

s0.title: Smart search
s0.description: Search by name, brand, or barcode—even with the scanner.

s2.title: Sorting
s2.description: Click column headers to sort ascending or descending.

s3.title: Add products
s3.description: Add catalog items; the scanner can autocomplete data.

s4.title: Export to PDF
s4.description: Print-ready documents with the current list and prices.

s5.title: Excel reports
s5.description: Download technical data for external analysis.

s6.title: Row actions
s6.description: Edit, delete, or restore products individually.

s0.title: Supplier search

s2.title: Register supplier

s3.title: PDF export

s4.title: Excel report
s4.description: Download supplier data for analysis or admin work.

s5.title: Individual management
s5.description: Open details, edit, or delete from each row.

s0.title: Culinary inspiration

s2.title: Quick sorting
s2.description: Sort by difficulty, prep time, or name.

s3.title: Create recipes
s3.description: Record preparations with ingredients, steps, and estimated costs.

s4.title: Let's cook!
s4.description: Use prepare to start production runs instantly, or open full technical sheets.

s1.title: New order

s2.title: Resume drafts

s3.title: Flow tracking

s4.title: PDF control

s4.title: Process steps
